name: QR Code
description: Generate QR codes as PNG or SVG and read QR codes from images
help: Codes are generated and decoded entirely in the local Rust engine.
Higher error correction survives more damage or a logo overlay but needs a larger code.
Keep enough contrast and a quiet zone of at least 4 modules so scanners can read the code.
Drop an image onto the window on the Read tab to decode every QR code in it.

generate.empty: Enter content to generate a QR code

decode.drop: Drop an image or click to choose
decode.dropHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP
decode.empty: Choose an image containing a QR code

errors.qr.too_long: The content ({{bytes}} bytes) is too long for a QR code at this error correction level
errors.qr.invalid_scale: Module size must be between 1 and {{max}}
errors.qr.invalid_margin: Quiet zone must be between 0 and {{max}}
errors.qr.invalid_color: “{{value}}” is not a valid hex color
errors.qr.encode_failed: Failed to render the QR code: {{detail}}
errors.qr.decode_failed: The image could not be read: {{detail}}
errors.qr.not_found: No QR code was found in the image
